# Snippr

> Snippr is online booking software for barbers, hairdressers and beauty salons. Each shop gets its own booking page and link (snipprcalendar.com/b/<shop>) plus a QR code; clients book 24/7, get email confirmations and reminders, and can cancel themselves. Snippr takes no commission on bookings.

- Pricing: one fixed monthly price per shop. Solo €14.95, Salon €34.95, Pro from €59.95 (excl. VAT). Every plan is free for 15 days, no card needed.
- Languages: English, Dutch, German, Turkish and Arabic.
- Based in the Netherlands.
